cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description: shlex.quote is not available in python 2. And the sleep is done via the shell not time.sleep() so that it does not block the main thread. Although, since this is macOS specific, one could use preexec_fn instead.
